data.one_liner: ESC/POS thermal WiFi printer support for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides support for ESC/POS thermal WiFi printers in pure Dart applications without Flutter dependencies. It allows generating printer commands, decoding printer data streams, and converting commands into printer documents.
use_when: You need to communicate with ESC/POS thermal printers from pure Dart backend or console applications.
You want a non-Flutter dependent solution for thermal receipt printing.
avoid_when: You are looking for a state management or UI components library.
strengths: Non-Flutter dependent, can be used in pure Dart applications.
Includes features for decoding ESC/POS commands and converting them to printer documents.
weaknesses: Limited to ESC/POS thermal printer support.
